name: Millstone Letters
description: A portrait sits in a finely grooved millstone above an oversized serif title and a generous reading column.

name: Rolled Reverie
description: Two pressed-grain portrait windows cross a broad colour band on a page with rolled paper edges.

name: Kilnlight Folio
description: An angular mill-house folio with a monumental title, offset registration marks and a bold ruled header.

name: Oatmilk Almanac
description: A folded-carton crown tops a photographic label, a side-set title and a softly framed writing panel.

name: Harvest Table
description: Two small saucer portraits sit above a woven placemat frame, a centred heading and an open neutral reading sheet.

name: Oatline
description: A tall smartphone with a pill-shaped contact portrait, a slim top camera and soft incoming bubbles.

name: Milling Messenger
description: A square e-ink communicator with a broad clock strip, ruled message cards and a grain-shaped navigation rocker.

name: Grain Frequency
description: A narrow pocket handset with a ribbed speaker, a small contact window and a round tuning control beneath the chat.

name: Soak Signal
description: A lock-screen phone with a large clock above a wide wallpaper portrait and translucent-looking neutral notification cards.

name: Porridge Pocket
description: A landscape pocket tablet with a stylus groove, a left-side clock and a separate recessed conversation pane.

name: Groatlet
description: A miniature reply inside a grain-like frame, with a small indented seam and a short centred heading.

name: Husk
description: A tiny portrait peeks from a split sleeve beside a compact reply and a narrow member-colour edge.

name: Branlet
description: A short square note with a scattered-flake corner, a divided title band and a crisp lower rule.

name: Flakefold
description: Two tiny pressed-oat portraits share a folded tab above a compact open reply.

name: Aftergrain
description: A miniature horizontal note with a three-colour stitched top edge and a small offset signature panel.
